name: Malfunctions: Cyberlimb & related borgware
description: Breaking Your Stuff, p.7. A short summary by Neon At Home; the DLC has the full text. Import this table and edit it to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy.

results.text: Dead option: one of the limb's options is switched off and can't be used; one already deployed (a Popup Weapon) can't be retracted. (For 1 minute)
Nervous tic: the limb gives your intentions away: -2 to Social Skill Checks. (For 1 minute)
Motion glitch: make a DV15 Concentration Check or drop a held item (cyberarm) or fall prone (cyberleg). (Right away)
Microfractures: a Critical Success on a Check made with the limb gives you the Torn Muscle Critical Injury. (For 1 hour)
Too much force: the limb lashes out at the nearest target, as a Brawling Attack. (Right away)
Locking joints: a cyberarm can't pick up or drop anything; a cyberleg gives -1 MOVE (minimum 1). (For 1 minute)
